metadata.citation: Bourgoin, Clement; Achard, Frederic; Beuchle, Rene; Carboni, Silvia; Carreiras, Joao; Marinelli, Daniele; Rotllan-Puig, Xavier; Simonetti, Dario; Colditz, Rene (2026): Global map of forest cover 2020 - version 4. European Commission, Joint Research Centre [Dataset] doi: 10.2905/JRC.3KATEH8 PID: http://data.europa.eu/89h/cf7c49ea-8f00-4c5a-bd40-6f25dc341580
limitations: Mapped product classes are observations, not legal forest/compliance findings.
Counts are native JRC cells, not hectares or whole-plot area; do not add/compare them as same-resolution Hansen counts.
Reference year 2020 differs from version v4 publication year 2026; v3 remains unavailable.
Pinned v4 XML has 2023 creation/publication and 2025 revision dates plus a v2 report DOI; these do not date the v4 release.
Official v4 technical report was still expected in December 2026 at review on 2026-10-13.
Source/compact equality proves representation preservation, not satellite-source accuracy.
metadata.query_grid: acquired JRC chip affine lattice; zero-based chip row/col; original centers before any window read

xml_observations.title: Global map of forest cover in 2020, version 4. Joint Research Centre, European Commission, https://forest-observatory.ec.europa.eu/forest/gfc2020

method.all_samples: all nine hot/encode calls and all nine cold children validated; seven retained timing samples plus two recorded warmups
method.cache: OS cache not evicted; guards pre-read files; process-cold, never disk-cold
method.cold: new ordinary Python process per repetition/warmup; imports and plot read excluded from inner load+query time; startup-inclusive wall separately
method.encoding: source already loaded; new files, manifest and encoder validation; buffered writes without fsync; deterministic bytes checked each trial
method.integrity: whole-file expected hashes including manifest/index inside every initialization; additional format/decoder integrity checks retained
method.p95: nearest rank, maximum of seven samples
method.query: 17 full dictionaries on preloaded native arrays; original global JRC center lattice
method.rss: isolated child lifetime peak, imports/validation included; encode child contains nine trials, not incremental memory
method.scope: one seen sparse native JRC chip; not universal format superiority or legal/source accuracy; no indexed measurements
method.validation_timing: answer/full-array digests and guard checks outside inner timing; loaders own checks inside

encoding.reason: native acquired source; no equivalent acquisition/recompression task measured

scientific_decision: Compare required totals and CPU/load costs in these rows; this is a research challenge to the custom format, not a production selection.
